# Jeremiah 17 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The-sin-of Judah [is] written with-a-pen-of iron, with-a-point-of diamond; it-is-engraved upon the-tablet-of their-heart and-upon-[the]-horns-of your-altars,

**2** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**3** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**4** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**5** Thus says YHWH: "Cursed [is] the-man who trusts in-mankind and-makes flesh his-arm, and-from YHWH his-heart departs.

**6** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**7** Blessed [is] the-man who trusts in-YHWH, and-YHWH is his-trust.

**8** And-he-shall-be like-a-tree planted by waters, and-by a-stream it-sends-out its-roots, and-does-not-see when-heat comes, and-its-foliage is green, and-in-[the]-year-of drought it-is-not anxious, and-does-not-cease from-bearing-fruit.

**9** Deceitful [is] the-heart above-all-things, and-desperately-sick [it is] — who can-know-it?

**10** I, YHWH, search the-heart, test the-kidneys, to-give to-each-man according-to-his-ways, according-to-[the]-fruit-of his-deeds.

**11** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**12** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**13** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**14** Heal-me, YHWH, and-I-will-be-healed; save-me and-I-will-be-saved, for My-praise You [are].

**15** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**16** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**17** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**18** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**19** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**20** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**21** Thus says YHWH: "Guard yourselves for-your-souls, and-do-not carry a-burden on-the-day-of the-Sabbath, and-do-not-bring-[it] through-[the]-gates-of Jerusalem.

**22** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**23** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**24** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**25** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**26** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

**27** And-YHWH spoke concerning the-sin-engraved upon-Judah's-heart and-the-blessedness-of trust in-Him.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **17:1**: Opening formula for the the sin of Judah oracle. Standard prophetic messenger formula with characteristic Jeremianic language.

- **17:13**: Central imagery of engraved sin — characteristic of Jeremiah's prophetic rhetoric and covenant lawsuit tradition.

- **17:27**: Concluding declaration — ne'um YHWH ('declares YHWH'). The divine speech formula seals the prophetic oracle.

— EMET
